producer.note: Not a refit output. Built from the v1 bundle + SP phase2/tailoring inputs so the console reproduces ADDENDUM section F.

deflator.cycle_rule: cpi[2025] / mean of the two calendar-year averages of the cycle

inference: Ordinary OLS p-values are primary. Industry slopes follow the refit auto-pick (pooled, own or DerSimonian-Laird blend); conditional on model selection
validation: Historical associations carried onto Mentat levels. Coefficient intervals cover slope uncertainty only; prediction intervals add the residual variance of the anchored step

interval_labels.prediction: 95% prediction interval (adds the anchored-step residual variance)

measures.label: Roster companies' PACs: own giving to House and Senate candidates (FEC committee-to-candidate, D-049)
Mentat general giving (included receipt amount, all channels)

anchor_options.label: Mentat's previous cycle; the next cycle is chained through the open cycle
Mentat's cycle of the same phase (presidential or midterm); one step each, no chaining

bases.label: Employees' included giving to candidate committees
Roster PACs' own giving to candidates

share.remainder_total_rule: projected measure x previous-cycle candidate share of that measure

pac_model.specification: Forward-selected PAC growth model with industry and cycle fixed effects; the reference cycle effect is held fixed for scenarios
pac_model.slope_rule_reason: FIXTURE: each industry's own slope, as the 2026-09-30 owner scenario applies it (ADDENDUM F.2); the refit auto-pick records its own choice here.

lobby_model.specification: Change in annual real lobbying on change in forecast annual growth, year effects; same pooled slope per industry, calendar effects held fixed

log_refit.unit: log points of the lobbying level per +1 pp of dg
log_refit.provenance: FIXTURE computed from SP phase2 p09_lobby_relative.R (lm(dly ~ dg + factor(year)) on the 71 LobbyView pairs); the R pipeline replaces it with its own log refit.

persistence.window: LobbyView sector-year levels (real 2025 dollars), target years 2014-2023, origin = the earlier year
persistence.method: e = log(level[t+h]) - log(level[t]), h = 1..3; q = the ceil((n + 1) * p)-th smallest |e| (split-conformal); per industry p = 0.80, pooled p = 0.80 and 0.95

political_inputs.market_rule: Mean P(Republican control) over January 1 to June 30 of the election year; Polymarket to Polymarket (2024 and 2026).

House.note: Kalshi has no 2024 January-June data (its 2024 series starts 2024-09-12). Polymarket window is partial: 131 of 182 days, from 2024-02-21.
